title: Judgment According to Works
definition: Judgment According to Works refers to God’s final righteous judgment.
summary: Judgment According to Works refers to God’s final righteous judgment.
christFocus: Christ is both the appointed Judge and the Savior who bore judgment for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Judgment According to Works places present life under the future God has promised. Evil, unbelief, and every hidden thing will be brought before god’s perfect justice.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. People need sober truth about accountability without cruelty or sensationalism.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Christ is both the appointed Judge and the Savior who bore judgment for His people. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. People need sober truth about accountability without cruelty or sensationalism. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Flee to Christ and live with holy seriousness. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
